## Code and output

```{r}
dat <- read.csv("data/template_example.csv")
head(dat, 4)
```

```{r}
mean(dat$expression)
```

## Figure with caption (from a chunk)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| opts.label: "M"
#| fig-cap: "Expression level by group (simulated data)."
ggplot(dat, aes(x = group, y = expression)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Group", y = "Expression")
```
